Acme Widgets $4.5M class action settlement

Acme Widgets has agreed to pay $4.5 million to resolve claims it overcharged customers for widget subscriptions.

Who's Eligible: Consumers in the United States who bought an Acme Widgets subscription between Jan. 1, 2019 and Dec. 31, 2023.

Potential Award: Up to $75

Proof of Purchase: No proof of purchase required

Claim Form Deadline: 03/15/27

Case Name: Smith v. Acme Widgets Inc., Case No. 3:22-cv-01234

Class Period:

1/1/19 – 12/31/23
